fixture.load: Full coupled ACNEXT TT direct bypass at each frequency. Y=(inverse(H_bypass)-I)/Rs already includes the 25ohm termination; no second Rt added.
fixture.voltage_reference: AC input is the open-circuit Thevenin source. Extra switch loss referenced to the same modeled selected route; fixture insertion also reported against native bypass.

measured_equal_length_LF_Ron_estimate.approximation: At 1kHz shunt current is negligible; gate/body DC leakage is neglected. This is a small-signal local estimate, not an RF switch compact model.

series_loss_budget.scope: First-order analytical sizing check, proposed screening budget, pending user approval. RF parasitics further consume headroom.

limitations: Scalar Ron, off feedthrough and shunts are independent synthetic sensitivities. No mapping from arbitrary width or bias to actual R/C is claimed.
The model lacks bias variation, transistor transit time, gate rail impedance, distributed MOS parasitics, junction nonlinearity, passives EM, device noise and control power.
Input source and termination match the native TT fixture; SS/FF, active buffer headroom and different termination are unmeasured here.
Weighted pilot fit and frozen FFE are outside this model. Reported phase fit is uniformly weighted at eight probe frequencies.
